hints.title: Unique Element Mutual Membership
hints.text: The result must include each shared value uniquely. Converting the first input array into a collection enables constant time presence queries.

hints.title: Deduplicated Inspection Invariant
hints.text: Iterating through the unique elements of the second input array ensures each intersection candidate is added at most once without duplicate checks.

hints.title: Two Collection Intersection Procedure
hints.text: Convert the first array into a unique collection. Then iterate over each unique element from the second array. If that element exists in the first collection, append it to the result array. Return the result array.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N + M) time and O(N + M) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every element against the other array using nested loops takes quadratic O(N * M) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Building a set for one or both arrays achieves linear O(N + M) runtime and requires O(N + M) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should note that output elements must be unique and discuss alternative sorted two-pointer approaches.
